<style>
/* ===== Kapalsantai article theme (palette: main #0077B6 / primary #0A77FF / secondary #F1C40F / black #192434) ===== */

/* Hide theme page title (e.g. "Elementor #10071") - generic, not tied to a page ID */
body:has(.ks-wrap) :is(.entry-header,.page-header,.page-title,.entry-title,.elementor-page-title,.post-title,.entry-meta,.post-meta,.byline,.posted-by){display:none!important}

/* Page background: soft sky gradient + circles, like kapalsantai.com */
.ks-wrap{position:relative;overflow-x:clip;background:
 radial-gradient(circle at 100% 36%,rgba(0,174,214,.30) 0 74px,transparent 75px),
 radial-gradient(circle at 0% 62%,rgba(0,119,182,.08) 0 150px,transparent 151px),
 linear-gradient(180deg,#E8F4FB 0%,#F5FAFD 36%,#FFFFFF 100%)!important}
.ks-wrap::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:60px;right:-150px;width:360px;height:360px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);box-shadow:0 0 0 46px rgba(255,255,255,.34),0 0 0 47px rgba(0,119,182,.07),0 0 0 100px rgba(255,255,255,.2),0 0 0 101px rgba(0,119,182,.05);pointer-events:none}
.ks-wrap::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:110px;right:12%;width:128px;height:128px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(241,196,15,.62),rgba(241,196,15,.22));pointer-events:none}
.ks-article,.ks-sidebar{position:relative;z-index:1}
.ks-sidebar{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:flex-start}
@media(max-width:1024px){.ks-sidebar{position:static}.ks-wrap::after{right:6%;width:90px;height:90px}}

/* Typography */
.ks-article .elementor-widget-text-editor,.ks-article .elementor-widget-text-editor :is(p,li){color:rgba(27,43,65,.74)!important}
.ks-article .elementor-widget-text-editor strong{color:#192434}
.ks-eyebrow{display:inline-block;margin:0;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,119,182,.10);color:#0077B6!important;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}

/* H2 with a trailing line - same pattern as "Why choose Kapalsantai" */
.ks-h2 .elementor-heading-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.ks-h2 .elementor-heading-title::after{content:"";flex:1 1 40px;min-width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,119,182,.28),rgba(0,119,182,0))}
.ks-cta .ks-h2 .elementor-heading-title::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.55),rgba(255,255,255,0))}

/* Links */
.ks-p a,.ks-faq a{color:#0A77FF;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.ks-cta a:not(.elementor-button){color:#F1C40F}

/* Images, table, FAQ */
.ks-article img{border-radius:18px}
.ks-article .wp-block-table{border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(0,119,182,.18)}
.ks-faq summary::marker{color:#0077B6}
.ks-faq details{transition:box-shadow .2s ease}
.ks-faq details[open]{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,119,182,.10)}

/* Sidebar cards */
.ks-side-title .elementor-heading-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ks-side-title .elementor-heading-title::before{content:"";flex:none;width:5px;height:20px;border-radius:3px;background:#F1C40F}
.ks-cta .ks-side-title .elementor-heading-title::before{background:#F1C40F}
.ks-card .widget_recent_entries ul,.ks-card .elementor-widget-wp-widget-recent-posts ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.ks-card .elementor-widget-wp-widget-recent-posts li{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,119,182,.12);line-height:1.45}
.ks-card .elementor-widget-wp-widget-recent-posts li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.ks-card .elementor-widget-wp-widget-recent-posts a{color:#192434;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.ks-card .elementor-widget-wp-widget-recent-posts a:hover{color:#0A77FF}
.ks-card .elementor-widget-wp-widget-recent-posts :is(h5,h2){display:none}
.ks-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.ks-chips a{padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,119,182,.10);color:#0077B6;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.ks-chips a:hover{background:#0077B6;color:#fff}

/* Clickable facts */
.ks-facts-hint{margin:0 0 10px!important;font-size:13px;color:rgba(27,43,65,.58)!important}
.ks-facts{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.ks-facts li{margin:0;padding:0}
.ks-facts a.ks-fact{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:#192434!important;font-weight:500;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none!important;transition:background .2s}
.ks-facts a.ks-fact::before{content:"";flex:none;width:4px;align-self:stretch;border-radius:4px;background:#F1C40F}
.ks-facts a.ks-fact::after{content:"\2193";flex:none;margin-left:auto;color:#0077B6;font-weight:700;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-3px);transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s}
.ks-facts a.ks-fact:hover,.ks-facts a.ks-fact:focus-visible{background:rgba(0,119,182,.08)}
.ks-facts a.ks-fact:hover::after,.ks-facts a.ks-fact:focus-visible::after{opacity:1;transform:none}
.ks-facts a.ks-fact:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0A77FF;outline-offset:2px}
@media(hover:none){.ks-facts a.ks-fact::after{opacity:.6;transform:none}}

/* Yellow highlighter (marker sweep) on the article passage */
.ks-target{border-radius:4px;scroll-margin-top:140px;background-image:linear-gradient(transparent 36%,rgba(241,196,15,.62) 36%,rgba(241,196,15,.62) 94%,transparent 94%);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:0 0;background-size:0 100%;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;transition:background-size .45s ease}
.ks-target.is-lit{background-size:100% 100%;transition:background-size 1s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ks-target,.ks-target.is-lit{transition:none}}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  var timer;
  function clearLit(){document.querySelectorAll('.ks-target.is-lit').forEach(function(e){e.classList.remove('is-lit')});}
  function go(id,updateHash){
    var el=document.getElementById(id); if(!el) return;
    var det=el.closest('details'); if(det) det.open=true;
    var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    clearLit(); clearTimeout(timer);
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect(), off=(r.top+r.height/2)-window.innerHeight/2, lit=false;
    function light(){ if(lit) return; lit=true; el.classList.add('is-lit'); timer=setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('is-lit')},6500); }
    el.scrollIntoView({behavior:reduce?'auto':'smooth',block:'center'});
    if(reduce||Math.abs(off)<10){ light(); }
    else{ window.addEventListener('scrollend',light,{once:true}); setTimeout(light,1100); }
    if(updateHash&&history.replaceState) history.replaceState(null,'','#'+id);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var a=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('a.ks-fact'); if(!a) return;
    var id=(a.getAttribute('href')||'').replace(/^#/,''); if(!document.getElementById(id)) return;
    e.preventDefault(); go(id,true);
  });
  if(/^#ks-t\d+$/.test(location.hash)){ window.addEventListener('load',function(){setTimeout(function(){go(location.hash.slice(1),false)},400)}); }

  /* Fallback: hide the theme's auto page title ("Elementor #1234") */
  function hideTitle(){
    document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,.entry-title,.page-title').forEach(function(h){
      if(h.closest('.ks-wrap')) return;
      var t=h.textContent.trim();
      if(/^Elementor\s*#\d+/i.test(t)){
        h.style.display='none';
        var p=h.parentElement;
        if(p&&p.textContent.trim()===t&&!p.matches('body,main,#content,#main,.site-main,.elementor')) p.style.display='none';
      }
    });
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',hideTitle); else hideTitle();
})();
</script>

settings.editor: KOMODO ISLAND TOUR • TRAVEL GUIDE 2027

settings.title: Komodo Island Tour: The 2027 Guide to Meet Komodo Dragons
settings._title: H1 · Komodo Island Tour: The 2027 Guide…

settings.editor: The boat slows down. Ahead, golden hills rise straight out of the sea, and a wooden jetty waits at Loh Liang. Somewhere on that savanna, a three-meter lizard is warming up in the morning sun.
settings._title: Teks · The boat slows down. Ahead,…

settings.editor: A Komodo Island tour is the one experience you cannot get anywhere else on earth. Komodo dragons live in the wild only on a few islands in East Nusa Tenggara, and Komodo Island is home to the largest population. Join a sailing trip from Labuan Bajo with Kapalsantai, and you will walk the same trails as these prehistoric predators, guided by a local ranger.
settings._title: Teks · A Komodo Island tour is…

settings.editor: Here is everything you need to plan your Komodo Island tour in 2027: trekking routes, safety rules, best season, fees, and what to pack.
settings._title: Teks · Here is everything you need…

settings.title: Why Is a Komodo Island Tour So Special?
settings._title: H2 · Why Is a Komodo Island Tour…
Sub · The Home of the World's…

settings.title: The Home of the World's Largest Lizard
settings._title: H3 · The Home of the World's Largest…

settings.editor: Komodo dragons (Varanus komodoensis) live naturally on only a handful of islands: Komodo, Rinca, Gili Motang, Gili Dasami, and parts of western Flores. Komodo Island holds the biggest population. As a result, seeing them here means seeing them truly wild, hunting deer and resting under tamarind trees.

settings._title: Sub · A UNESCO World Heritage Landscape

settings.title: A UNESCO World Heritage Landscape
settings._title: H3 · A UNESCO World Heritage Landscape

settings.editor: UNESCO named Komodo National Park a World Heritage Site in 1991. On Komodo Island, dry savanna, rocky ridges, and monsoon forest meet the sea. Besides dragons, you may spot Timor deer, wild boar, and the rare yellow-crested cockatoo.
settings._title: Teks · UNESCO named Komodo National Park…

settings.title: Things to Do on a Komodo Island Tour
settings._title: H2 · Things to Do on a Komodo…

settings.title: 1. Guided Trekking at Loh Liang
settings._title: H3 · 1. Guided Trekking at Loh Liang

settings.editor: Every visit starts at the Loh Liang ranger station. You cannot walk alone, because an official guide with a forked stick leads every group. Guides usually offer routes of different lengths, so pick the one that fits your group:
settings._title: Teks · Every visit starts at the…

settings.editor: In general, the trails are flat and wide. Your ranger chooses the route based on the season and on where dragons appeared that day.
settings._title: Teks · In general, the trails are…

settings.editor: Pink Beach (Pantai Merah) sits on the coast of Komodo Island. The pink color of its sand comes from tiny fragments of red organisms mixed with white sand. Just offshore, shallow reefs are home to clownfish, parrotfish, and the occasional sea turtle. Also, check the availability of the snorkeling gear provided on trips with Kapalsantai.

settings.title: 3. Combine It With Padar, Manta Point, and Taka Makassar
settings._title: H3 · 3. Combine It With Padar, Manta…

settings.editor: Komodo Island is rarely a single stop. That is why most sailing itineraries pair it with the sunrise hike on Padar Island, a drift snorkel at Manta Point, and a walk around the Taka Makassar sandbank.
settings._title: Teks · Komodo Island is rarely a…
Section 03 · Komodo Island Tour Safety Rules

settings.title: Komodo Island Tour Safety Rules
settings._title: H2 · Komodo Island Tour Safety Rules

settings.editor: Komodo dragons are wild predators. Therefore, follow these rules on every Komodo Island tour to keep yourself and the animals safe:
settings._title: Teks · Komodo dragons are wild predators.…

settings.editor:
1. Stay With Your Ranger
    Never leave the group or wander off the trail.
  2. Keep Your Distance
    Stay at least 5 meters away, even when a dragon looks asleep.
  3. Tell the Ranger About Wounds
    Dragons are sensitive to the smell of blood. Let your ranger know if you have an open wound or are menstruating.
  4. No Food, No Flash
    Never feed the animals, and turn off your camera flash.

settings._title: Section 04 · When Is the Best Time…

settings.title: When Is the Best Time for a Komodo Island Tour?
settings._title: H2 · When Is the Best Time for…

settings.editor:
• April to October (dry season): Clear skies, calm seas, and dry trails. Dragons are easier to spot on the open savanna. This is also peak season, so book early.
  • November to March (rainy season): Greener hills and fewer boats, but choppier seas and slippery paths. Some trips may change route due to weather.
Around the mating season in the middle of the year, dragons can be less visible near the main trails of a Komodo Island tour. However, your ranger will know where to look.
settings._title: Teks · Around the mating season in…
Section 05 · Komodo National Park Fees and…

settings.title: Komodo National Park Fees and Visitor Quota
settings._title: H2 · Komodo National Park Fees and Visitor…

settings.editor: All visitors on a Komodo Island tour pay a national park entrance ticket plus guide and local fees. Fees for foreign and Indonesian visitors are different and have changed several times, so always check the latest rate before you travel.
settings._title: Teks · All visitors on a Komodo…

settings.editor: Since 1 April 2026, the park limits visits to 1,000 people per day, booked through the park's SiOra system. On Kapalsantai trips, our team handles permits and quota booking for you, so you can relax and enjoy the trip.

Is it safe to visit Komodo Island?

Yes, as long as you follow your ranger's instructions. Trained rangers accompany every group, and visitors must stay on the marked trails. Also, let the ranger know if you have an open wound or are menstruating, so they are aware of what can and cannot be done.
settings._title: FAQ · Is it safe to visit Komodo…

settings.editor:
Will I definitely see a Komodo dragon?

Sightings are very likely, especially in the dry season, but they are never guaranteed. After all, these are wild animals that move freely.
settings._title: FAQ · Will I definitely see a Komodo…

settings.editor:
How do I get to Komodo Island from Labuan Bajo?

By boat only. Most travelers join a day trip or a multi-day sailing trip from Labuan Bajo. Travel time depends on the boat type and the itinerary, so check out your preferred trip on Kapalsantai.
settings._title: FAQ · How do I get to Komodo…

settings.editor:
Can I fly a drone on Komodo Island?

Drones need a separate permit from the park authority, so ask your operator or Kapalsantai’s customer service before your trip.
settings._title: FAQ · Can I fly a drone on…

settings.title: What to Pack for a Komodo Island Tour
settings._title: H2 · What to Pack for a Komodo…

settings.editor:
• Closed-toe walking shoes for the trek
  • Light, long-sleeved clothing and a hat
  • Reef-safe sunscreen
  • A refillable water bottle
  • Swimwear and a rash guard for Pink Beach
  • Power bank and spare camera battery

settings.editor: Standing a few meters from a living dinosaur is something you will talk about for years. Pair it with Pink Beach, Padar's sunrise, and the mantas of Komodo, and you have one of the best sea journeys in Indonesia.
